checks.title: Behavioral review of every script
checks.requiredVerification: Per-script input/output/side-effect, failure, timing and research-boundary review with linked evidence; targeted regressions for defects. Inventory/syntax alone cannot close this.
tests: Per-script contract review and risk-based regression; tests are not a substitute for reading side effects.
checks.evidenceRequired: Per-script input/output/side-effect, failure, timing and research-boundary review with linked evidence; targeted regressions for defects. Inventory/syntax alone cannot close this.
checks.currentGap: Unreviewed large modules remain real unfinished branch work, not an external blocker.
checks.shortestSafeRoute: Review unreviewed modules in shared I/O families, record individual contracts and repair defects; no broad rerun while investigating.

checks.title: All workflow failure/write/concurrency semantics
checks.requiredVerification: Per-workflow and helper review of checkout/ref, writes, retries, conflict handling, concurrency, secrets, failure saving and retention. Real disposable-Git conflict/retry tests for repaired publication paths. No production dispatch.
checks.evidenceRequired: Per-workflow and helper review of checkout/ref, writes, retries, conflict handling, concurrency, secrets, failure saving and retention. Real disposable-Git conflict/retry tests for repaired publication paths. No production dispatch.
checks.currentGap: 86 workflows and 137 publication/rebase sites have differing failure/conflict policies. Parsed semantic inventory is not a completed behavioral review.
checks.shortestSafeRoute: Consolidate conflict contracts by template, inject disposable-Git races/refusals on each distinct writer; retain both frozen results. Do not dispatch production.
checks.continuationEvidence: Verified Smart-money save repair 2b96707b242e4ac55cc8ec006211a00ebe2867b9: docs/validation/smart-money-publication-ci.json; other writer families unfinished.
